definitions.explanation: The shared opinion or will of an entire group, organization, or populace. Emphasizes that everyone in the group agrees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総意|そうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧。
examples.english: It is based on the consensus of the people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総意|そうい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The plan was decided by the consensus of all employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{部署|ぶしょ}→部署：08187_busho⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総意|そうい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}→提出：03542_teishutsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{意見書|いけんしょ}です。
examples.english: This is a written opinion submitted as the consensus of the entire department.

notes:
USAGE:
{総意|そうい} carries a formal, weighty tone and implies that the group has reached unanimous or near-unanimous agreement. It appears frequently in legal, political, and organizational contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総意|そうい} (the will of the people)
- {総意|そうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づく→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧ (based on consensus)
- {総意|そうい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{反映|はんえい}する→反映する：17186_haneisuru⟧ (to reflect the collective will)
- {総意|そうい}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as the consensus)
